title: AnymeX Tracker Add-on Manifest
description: Validation schema for community tracker and metadata service manifests in AnymeX.

$schema.description: URI pointing to this JSON schema for IDE autocomplete and validation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the add-on (e.g. kitsu, shikimori, trakt).

name.description: Display name of the service shown in the UI.

author.description: Author or maintainer of this add-on manifest.

description.description: Short description of the service and capabilities.

icon.description: Remote URL to a favicon or icon image.

capabilities.description: Media categories supported by this service.

type.description: Authentication method used by the service.

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI for OAuth2 callback (default: anymex://callback).

client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID if public or embedded.

client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret if public or embedded.

token_response_path.description: Dot-path to extract the access token from the token exchange response (default: access_token).

refresh_token_path.description: Dot-path to extract the refresh token from response (default: refresh_token).

instructions_url.description: Help URL opened in browser to explain how user can obtain their API token.

login_url.description: POST endpoint URL for username/password login.

body_template.description: JSON payload template for credentials login (supports {username}, {password}).

base_url.description: Base URL prepended to all relative endpoint paths.

headers.description: HTTP request headers sent with all requests.

title.description: Display title for the home carousel.

is_anime.description: Whether items are anime (true) or manga (false).

items_path.description: Dot-path to the array of items in the API response.

home_sections.description: Carousels displayed on the AnymeX home feed.

user_profile.description: Endpoint to fetch profile of logged-in user.

user_library.description: Endpoint to fetch user watch/reading list (supports {userId}, {type}, {status}).

create_entry.description: Endpoint to add a new media to the user's library (supports {userId}, {mediaId}, {type}, {targetType}, {status}, {progress}, {score}).

delete_entry.description: Endpoint to delete an entry from user library (supports {entryId}).

calendar.description: Optional endpoint returning an array of upcoming anime schedule/release episodes.

endpoints.description: Definitions for all API routes called by AnymeX.

status_map.description: Maps third-party status strings to AnymeX canonical statuses.

reverse_status_map.description: Maps AnymeX canonical statuses (CURRENT, PLANNING, etc.) back to third-party status strings.

url.description: Endpoint path with optional variable placeholders (e.g. {query}, {page}, {limit}, {offset}).

response_path.description: Dot-path to extract the target data object from response.

items_path.description: Dot-path to extract an array of items from response.

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

mapping.description: Field mapping rules using dot-notation, arrays, and fallback operators (||).

body_template.description: JSON payload template for mutation requests.
